scope: all public world maps including tutorial; no per-character map instances
failure_policy: stale logout cannot retire another participant or shared scene
no map reset when one of multiple players leaves
different map content revision must not silently create per-character scene
native packet schema unknown => no fabricated packet to unmodified Client
new join receives current state and never resurrects already dead actor via stale events

reward_allocation.damage: actual server-validated effective HP damage grouped by party_id at damage event, solo is singleton party
reward_allocation.winner: single team with highest total; ties policy pending
reward_allocation.experience: 100% monster base EXP credited to each eligible winner member, not split
reward_allocation.drop: each winner member independently resolves full loot table once; item not guaranteed; loser parties none
reward_allocation.audit: persistent once-only damage/death/reward roll per monster life and character
